title: Game-Ware Vol. 3
overview:
Game-Ware Vol. 3 is the third issue of a magazine on CD-ROM for the Sega Saturn, with small games, videos, interviews and advertisements.

- Pipitboy no Daibouken 3, now a head-to-head falling-block puzzle
- Legend of Sarah: the Virtua Fighter digital comic serial continues
- Edison returns as a serial
- Oniisan: a new digital comic adventure serial
- Schick Protector Man: a block-breaking game
- Information corner featuring Virtua Cop 2, Sega Touring Car Championship, Mothra and Denki Groove
